fields.description: The Source II is Aldar’s second wellness-focused release at Saadiyat Grove. One to three-bedroom apartments are paired with bathing, exercise and social facilities, with two penthouses identified for a later release in the original announcement.

overview: The scheme’s shared bathhouse and fitness spaces make wellness facilities a central part of the residential offer. Aldar also describes social kitchens, gardens and coworking areas. These are communal facilities; a private pool or spa should not be assumed for a standard apartment.
research.locationNote: In Saadiyat Grove on Saadiyat Island, within Abu Dhabi’s Cultural District. The developer identifies the Zayed National Museum and nearby cultural institutions as part of the setting; views depend on the chosen home.
research.priceNote: Aldar’s launch announcement starts at AED 2.82m. This historical reference is not a current quotation or a promise of remaining primary stock.
research.paymentNote: The launch sheet offers 60/40 and 70/30, both with 10% booking. JRE associates 60/40 with back-view homes and 70/30 with front-view homes. The table shows the former only; confirm the selected unit’s plan and any later amendments.
research.handoverNote: The launch expected Q4 2026; Aldar’s FY2025 pipeline lists 2027. Confirm the current schedule.

facts.value: The official announcement describes 148 residences and separately mentions two penthouses to be released later. The marketing fact sheet states 146 units. Confirm the final approved schedule rather than treating either figure as current inventory.

facts.label: Energy design target
facts.value: The launch announcement targeted at least 18% lower energy use against the ASHRAE 2010 baseline. This is a design target, not a measured saving for an occupied home.
